definitions.title: Trapezoidal Rule and Simpson's Rule
definitions.latex: T_n = \frac{\Delta x}{2} [y_0 + 2y_1 + 2y_2 + \dots + 2y_{n-1} + y_n], \quad S_n = \frac{\Delta x}{3} [y_0 + 4y_1 + 2y_2 + 4y_3 + \dots + y_n]
definitions.statement: Numerical quadrature algorithms to approximate definite integrals when antiderivatives cannot be expressed in elementary terms. Simpson's Rule fits parabolic arcs across pairs of subintervals (n must be even).
conditions: n is even for Simpson's Rule
definitions.explanation: Trapezoidal error scales with (Delta x)^2; Simpson's error scales with (Delta x)^4.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Simpson's Rule integrates cubic polynomials with zero error.
